note: A miner, and the hat is the whole of him at a hundred paces.

Every villager in this game was the same sixteen boxes in different trousers, so a village of eleven trades read as one man repeated. What tells a trade apart from above is a silhouette, not a colour — and a hard hat is the one piece of kit in the world that is worn on the head, is a shape nothing else has, and is yellow because it is meant to be seen in the dark.
Broader than an ordinary villager. A man who swings a pick all day is built like one, and it is also the first thing `build` was put in for.

parts.note: the crown, sitting down over the hair rather than balanced on it — the mistake the hero's hat was corrected for
the brim, wider than the crown all the way round: what makes it a hard hat and not a cap

the rib over the crown, which is the detail that says moulded rather than knitted. Set a fraction above the crown's top face rather than on it: two faces at the same height fight for the same pixels and the hat shimmers as the camera turns
the lamp on the front of it. Not lit — that is `herogear.ts`'s trick and belongs to the hero — but it is the shape you look for
